# Called through purego (the Go language's `cgo` option set to "purego"), a
# C function is opened from the library its c.link names, and crosses Go's
# own values: what purego cannot do is refused, naming what it is.

# A package whose c.link ships C to compile: purego has no compiler. gtk4's
# runtime is C until the runtimes become SNGL.
! sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --opt cgo=purego -o out window.sngl
stderr 'purego compiles no C, and the package declaring it ships sngl_gtk.c'

# A c.link naming no library: nothing says what to open.
! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --opt cgo=purego -o out nolib.sngl
stderr 'cos: purego opens the library a c.link names \(library=…\), and the package declaring it names none'

# A ref C fills: purego hands C no Go address.
! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --opt cgo=purego -o out ref.sngl
stderr 'div_into takes q: purego hands C no address to fill'

# A callback: purego's are never given back.
! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --opt cgo=purego -o out callback.sngl
stderr 'sum takes f: purego''s callbacks are never given back'

# A string C hands over to free: purego copies it and keeps no pointer.
! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --opt cgo=purego -o out frees.sngl
stderr 'strdup hands over a string free frees \(#\[c.frees\]\): purego copies a string C answers'

# A member of a C struct: purego finds a function by its name alone.
! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --opt cgo=purego -o out field.sngl
stderr 'thing.year is a member of a C struct \(field\): purego opens a C function by its name'

# A pointer C takes as an integer typedef (#[c.type]): purego would hand
# it as a number, keeping nothing it points to; and a number made a
# pointer, which only C makes.
! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --opt cgo=purego -o out intptr.sngl
stderr 'send takes text as the integer param \(#\[c.type\]\): purego casts no pointer to an integer'
! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --opt cgo=purego -o out intcast.sngl
stderr 'asThing makes a thing \* of a number, which purego cannot'

-- window.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text("x")
}
-- nolib.sngl --
import c "sngl:x/c"
import ui "sngl:ui"

c.link(include="math.h", system=true)

#[c.native("cos")]
func cos(x float) float

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text("{cos(0.0)}")
}
-- ref.sngl --
import c "sngl:x/c"
import ui "sngl:ui"

c.link(include="stdlib.h", system=true, library="c")

#[c.native("div_into")]
func divide(a int, q ref[int])

func f() int {
    var q = 0
    divide(7, &q)
    return q
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text("{f()}")
}
-- callback.sngl --
import c "sngl:x/c"
import ui "sngl:ui"

c.link(include="sum.h", system=true, library="sum")

#[c.native("sum")]
func sum(n int, f func(int) int, #[c.context] data c.pointer) int

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text("{sum(3, func(i int) => i * 2)}")
}
-- frees.sngl --
import c "sngl:x/c"
import ui "sngl:ui"

c.link(include="string.h", system=true, library="c")

#[c.native("strdup")]
#[c.frees("free")]
func dup(s string) string

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text("{dup("x")}")
}
-- field.sngl --
import c "sngl:x/c"
import ui "sngl:ui"

c.link(include="thing.h", system=true, library="thing")

#[c.native("thing *")]
struct Thing {}

#[c.native("thing_new")]
func newThing() Thing

#[c.native("thing.year", field)]
func year(t Thing) int

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text("{year(newThing())}")
}
-- intptr.sngl --
import c "sngl:x/c"
import ui "sngl:ui"

c.link(include="thing.h", system=true, library="thing")

#[c.native("send")]
func send(#[c.type("param")] text string) int

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text("{send("x")}")
}
-- intcast.sngl --
import c "sngl:x/c"
import ui "sngl:ui"

c.link(include="thing.h", system=true, library="thing")

#[c.native("param")]
struct Param = int

#[c.native("thing *")]
struct Thing {}

#[c.native("noted")]
func noted() Param

#[c.native("thing *", cast)]
func asThing(p Param) Thing

#[c.native("thing_year")]
func year(t Thing) int

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text("{year(asThing(noted()))}")
}
